name: resolve_mode
description: Resolve a Bubbles workflow mode to its fully-expanded YAML definition with template inheritance applied. Wraps mode-resolver.sh against bubbles/workflows.yaml. Supply EITHER 'mode' (a registered key, or '--list-modes' to enumerate) OR the v7 form as 'primitive' plus 'tags'. The resolver requires the v7 form as SEPARATE argv elements, so passing 'review action:readiness-synthesis target:system' as one string is rejected. Removed v5 names need grandfather=true. Use to discover a mode's phases, gates, status ceiling, and termination criteria before dispatch.

mode.description: Registered mode key (e.g. 'bugfix-fastlane', 'spec-scope-hardening'), or '--list-modes' to enumerate every defined mode. Mutually exclusive with primitive/tags. A removed v5 name is REJECTED here unless grandfather=true.

primitive.description: v7 primitive, e.g. 'review'. Use together with tags. Mutually exclusive with mode.

tags.description: v7 tags, one per entry, e.g. ['action:readiness-synthesis', 'target:system'].

grandfather.description: Resolve a PERSISTED v5 mode key, such as one already stored in a state.json. New operator input must use primitive+tags; without this the resolver rejects removed v5 names and tells you the v6 form. Emits --grandfather, which also prints a deprecation line on stderr.
